name: heading
label: Rail heading
help_text: Renders using the theme's global typography - no color settings on this module.
default: Left Rail Holds the Heading and the Takeaway

name: takeaway
label: Rail takeaway sentence
help_text: The one bolded, Purple 900 summary sentence under the rail heading - always rendered bold and purple, regardless of formatting applied in the editor.
default: One bolded purple summary sentence the skimmer leaves with.

name: show_accent
label: Show top accent line
help_text: Optional decorative color bar above the rail heading, matching the Hero module's accent line.

name: body_content
label: Running copy
help_text: The right column's full read - repeat Heading + paragraph pairs as needed. Renders using the theme's global typography - no color settings on this module. List markers use the theme's global blue-dot bullet color automatically.
default:
Sub-Head Opens the Running Copy

The right column carries the full read. The rail stays fixed while this column scrolls - the pattern for methodology, compliance detail, and audit narrative.

Sub-Heads Break Every Two to Three Paragraphs

Keeps the wall of text scannable without cards or callouts. Blue-dot bullets allowed; imagery is not - this module is deliberately type-only.

Closing paragraph ends with the section's one link

children.name: spacing_desktop
children.label: Desktop spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding on desktop. Left/right are hidden - horizontal spacing comes from .content-wrapper.

children.name: spacing_mobile
children.label: Mobile spacing
children.help_text: Top/bottom padding at the theme's mobile breakpoint (max-width: 767px), independent of the desktop value above.
